# `website` — `/api/webmaster`

The Grove's website: the pages visitors see at its address, published from a folder in Files.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/webmaster/files`](#get-api-webmaster-files) | Webmaster | Everything in a website's folder, for the site editor, with this webmaster's drafts. |
| DELETE | [`/api/webmaster/live`](#delete-api-webmaster-live) | Webmaster | Takes the published website down (webmasters). |
| POST | [`/api/webmaster/previews`](#post-api-webmaster-previews) | Space member | Anyone in the Grove may look at its websites before they're published. |
| POST | [`/api/webmaster/publish`](#post-api-webmaster-publish) | Webmaster | Publishes a site folder of a space as the Grove's website (webmasters who are members of the space). |
| POST | [`/api/webmaster/releases/{rid}/live`](#post-api-webmaster-releases-rid-live) | Webmaster | Makes a kept release the live website again (webmasters). |
| GET | [`/api/webmaster/site`](#get-api-webmaster-site) | Member | The published website, every space's sites, and, for owners and webmasters, the kept releases. |

<a id="get-api-webmaster-files"></a>
### `GET /api/webmaster/files`

Everything in a website's folder, for the site editor, with this webmaster's drafts.

- Handler: [`site_files`](../../../backend/community/website.py)
- Who may call: Grove owners and webmasters who are members of the space

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `space_id` | query | string | yes |  |  |
| `folder` | query | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `space_id`, `folder`, `items` (JSON list, each item JSON object with the fields of a row of `file_drafts`: `file_id`, `version`, `updated`, `draft`)

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Only this Grove’s owners and webmasters can do this. | `webmaster` |
| 404 | Space not found. | `membership` |
| 404 | Website not found. | `site_folder` |
| 422 | Folders go 20 deep at most. | `clean_folder` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 422 | Use a name of up to 200 characters, without slashes. | `clean_name` |
| 422 | {folder} needs a page called index.html at its top. It’s the front page. | `site_folder` |

<a id="post-api-webmaster-publish"></a>
### `POST /api/webmaster/publish`

Publishes a site folder of a space as the Grove's website (webmasters who are members of the space).

- Handler: [`publish`](../../../backend/community/website.py)
- Who may call: Grove owners and webmasters who are members of the space

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `SiteBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `space_id` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 64 characters |
| `folder` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 4200 characters |

**Response**

- `201`: JSON object with the fields of a row of `site_releases`: `id`, `space_id`, `folder`, `files`, `bytes`, `user_id`, `created`, `space_name`, `user_name`, plus `live`, or `null`, `hidden`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Only this Grove’s owners and webmasters can do this. | `webmaster` |
| 404 | Space not found. | `membership` |
| 404 | Website not found. | `site_folder` |
| 422 | Folders go 20 deep at most. | `clean_folder` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 422 | Use a name of up to 200 characters, without slashes. | `clean_name` |
| 422 | {folder} needs a page called index.html at its top. It’s the front page. | `site_folder` |
